Hi Julia / Sam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our onboarding checklist, I wanted to lock down the implementation sprint cadence and capture the vector DB decision to keep everyone aligned before we schedule the kickoff. High level proposal below — please flag anything missing.

Summary / asks
- Sprint cadence: 3x two-week sprints (migration prep, backfill + smoke, rerank tuning + cutover).
- Planned backfill window: incremental backfill over 5 nights (low-traffic 10pm–4am PT) with a validating sample run the weekend prior.
- Vector DB: shortlist is Milvus (self-host), managed cloud (VectorCloud), or Pinecone — we need your preference on managed vs. self-hosted by EOD Monday so we can finalize infra.
- Rerank evals: we’ll run a 2k prompt/ground-truth set for NDCG and MRR comparison across current ranker, embeddings-only, and embeddings+rerank. Expect results within Sprint 2.

Milestones & owners (preliminary)
- Sprint 0 (this week): finalize infra decision (ACME + Redwood), export sample payloads, mapping doc (Grace).
- Sprint 1: instrumentation + canary embedding generator (Marissa), schema + tokenization audit (ACME engineering).
- Sprint 2: backfill + smoke tests (Marissa), rerank evaluation (Rishi).
- Sprint 3: cutover, rollback playbook, and production monitoring (Grace + Rishi).

Risks I want to call out now
- Tokenization mismatch between your current pipeline and Redwood embedding model — will surface noisy vectors unless we align preprocessing.
- Backfill speed vs. latency trade-off (batch size / concurrency) — will propose config after we know infra.
- Embedding dimension / model drift that could reduce rerank gains; we’ll keep a hold-back sample for re-training.

Attachments: acme_mvp_migration_spec.xlsx (high-level), backfill-schedule.csv (proposed dates).

Can you confirm: (1) decision on managed vs. self-hosted vector DB, (2) acceptance of the 5-night incremental backfill window, and (3) preferred kickoff time on Tuesday?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

+1 on managed for initial rollout if ACME doesn't want to run infra. Quick technical notes to help with the Pinecone vs VectorCloud question and smoke criteria.

Vector DB tradeoffs (10M vectors, 1536-dim embeds)
- Pinecone (managed): predictable latency at scale, strong autoscaling, fast indexing, but costs can be higher for heavy write/backfill workloads. Good SDKs for python/java.
- VectorCloud (managed): cheaper write throughput in our tests, slightly higher 99th percentile tail latency on heavy queries; supports hybrid storage policies that may reduce cost.
- Milvus (self-host): full control, best for custom scoring and experimental plugins, but requires ops (SLA risk unless ACME adds runbook).

Recommendation: start with Pinecone for read-heavy traffic and higher SLOs; switch to VectorCloud if cost of backfill/write throughput becomes prohibitive. If you truly need custom scoring or locality-based sharding, we can revisit Milvus in Sprint 3.

Backfill approach (recommended)
1) Export current corpus snapshot -> validate hashing/IDs.
2) Run a 1% sample backfill weekend before full run (validate vector integrity + rerank delta).
3) Full incremental backfill over 5 nights with per-batch verification and paused commit until smoke tests pass.

Smoke criteria (proposed)
- Latency: 95th percentile query < 220ms (from ingest to result) under canary traffic.
- Correctness: NDCG@10 improvement > 10% over baseline for the validation set OR no material regression (> -2% allowed).
- Error rate: < 0.5% failed queries during run.

Attachments: vector_db_tradeoffs.pdf (benchmarks), backfill-schedule.csv (updated with per-batch windows).

Will prepare a short runbook and the rollback command set tomorrow. Rishi — can you own the rerank metric collection and eval dashboards?

- Metrics: NDCG@1/3/10, MRR, precision@k, and query latency distribution.
- Ablation: baseline vs embeddings-only vs embeddings+rerank (use the same embed model in all runs).
- Release gate: no more than -2% NDCG regression and latency within smoke criteria.
